dataset: phs003178 / SCP2079 (BRAF V600E CRC Phase 2 trial scRNA-seq)
intended_analysis: Compute immune composite (CD8A/CD3D/CD68 + CD274/PDCD1/FOXP3) per patient from 95,421 cells x 36,591 genes (23 paired pre/day-15 biopsies); test association with response and on-treatment immune-program induction.

paths_probed.result: HTTP 401 on /api/v1/studies/SCP2079; page requires Google/Broad sign-in

fallback: Literature-grounded predictive support (Evidence nodes evidence:braf_trial:immune_induction + evidence:braf_trial:pretreatment_null) minted from the published findings; raw recompute deferred until access granted.
unblock_actions: User creates a free Broad Single Cell Portal account and downloads SCP2079 expression matrix, OR
User requests access to Zenodo record 19958545, OR
User obtains dbGaP phs003178 via eRA Commons DUA (package prepared: dac_requests/phs003178_dbgap.md)
honest_note: Per the publication, pre-treatment TMB/CMS/BM1-BM2 did NOT predict response; only on-treatment immune-program induction did. The pre-treatment proxy is therefore expected to be null for response in this cohort - reported, not hidden.
